items.title: John "Picky" Brunious Interview, 1959-05-26
items.q: Piku was a teacher over there. ... Morellis was teaching me. Yeah. See, I didn't, Piku was teaching the night class. Yeah. And I was going to day class.

ctx.x: Yeah, so, uh, well, I played in that, uh, let's see, WPA band now. What else? Yeah, so after the WPA band broke up, well, to keep us, they gave, they sent us to what they, I don't know if they called it, they called it something else before, but it was a trade school. That's why I went to Xavier University. And I was learning how to be a tinsmith. You know? But Piku, huh? Huh? Piku used to be a tinsmith. Piku, that's right. Because Piku was a teacher over there.
